name: Incendia Agave
summary: Beneath Darkcloud Pinnacle, Incendia Agave grows in the Boiling Pool. A skilled shaman can enchant it to kindle the sacred fire of life.

sections.title: A Rare Desert Herb
sections.body: In Thousand Needles, Incendia Agave grows in and around the waters of the Boiling Pool, beneath Darkcloud Pinnacle. Wandering steam elementals guard the scarce plant, making it difficult to harvest. Though it grows underwater, the plant holds natural elements suited to rituals of flame.

sections.title: The Sacred Fire
sections.body: Tauren ritualists cannot kindle the dormant sacred fire of life with ordinary sparks. Elder Magatha Grimtotem, on Elder Rise in Thunder Bluff, can enchant harvested bushels of Incendia Agave into a mystical powder. The powder lights the ceremonial brazier used to summon the vengeful wind serpent Arikara.

faq.answer: Incendia Agave grows in and around the lake at the Boiling Pool beneath Darkcloud Pinnacle in northern Thousand Needles. Much of it lies submerged along the lakebed.

faq.q: What is Incendia Agave used for?
faq.answer: Ten bushels of Incendia Agave are gathered and made into ritual powder. Magatha Grimtotem enchants it in Thunder Bluff to light the sacred fire of life and summon Arikara.

faq.q: Who can enchant the Incendia Agave?
faq.answer: Magatha Grimtotem, an influential shaman on Elder Rise in Thunder Bluff, has the ritual knowledge to enchant Incendia Agave.

faq.q: What threats surround the Incendia Agave?
faq.answer: Hostile steam elementals roam the waters and shores of the Boiling Pool. They are exceptionally resistant to frost and fire spells.

angles.text: As a shaman, you can use raw elemental craft to turn the aquatic plant into powder potent enough to kindle sacred ritual flames.
As a herbalist, your tracking sense helps you find Incendia Agave's spiky clumps along the murky floor of the Boiling Pool.
